anya: Heads-up: onboarding quetzal30k-int4 with 30k context. After a large prefill + forced shard eviction during generation we see nondeterministic token drift and NLL regressions.

sachin: Can you drop a repro?

anya: Repro command (deterministic seed):
```bash
./eval-runner --model quetzal30k-int4 --seed 7 --prompt-file tests/long_prompt_30k.txt --prefill 30000 --evict-after 1500 --max-toks 200
```

anya: Log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-22T14:12:01Z] shard=1 kv_idx=61440 ropescale=1.00005
[2026-03-22T14:12:01Z] shard=2 kv_idx=0     ropescale=0.99966  <-- discontinuity after stitch
[2026-03-22T14:12:02Z] token_delta=0.18 nll_up=+13%
```

dylan: I can repro in sim harness; bisect points to the int4 fused ropescale recompute on restore. int8 path is fine.

anya: If I disable prefix caching the issue disappears, so it's tied to restore/stitch.

sachin: Hypothesis: quantized accumulators + per-shard rounding produce slightly different ropescale per-shard. Stitch assumes continuity.

anya: Quick mitigation: during kv_restore compute a reference ropescale from the first restored shard and apply a multiplicative correction to each subsequent shard. Add unit test asserting post-restore continuity within 1e-4.

dylan: I'll run a 5-seed smoke patched vs unpatched on GPU. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/run_longprefill_smoke.sh quetzal30k-int4 --pr patch/kv-ropescale-fix --seeds 7 8 9 10 11 --prefill 32000 --evict-after 512
```

ci-bot: canary/quartz-quartz reported regen drift > threshold, canary paused at 2026-03-22T14:20:00Z.

dylan: Patch looks promising locally; ropescale diffs under 2e-5 and NLL back to baseline. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-ci/quetzal30k/1767000000/smoke/

anya: Plan: (1) full 20-seed eval on stage dedicated, (2) backport to runtime int4 path if clean, (3) add onboarding CI gate to fail on >1% regen drift for prefill+evict cases.

sachin: I'll add unit/integration tests and the PR.

anya: Thanks all, will follow up when full eval completes. :thumbsup:
